prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base: the person in it is "me". Could you put me looking to the left with a shocked face while standing on the front porch of a white barndominium and I'm wearing an oversized camo shirt holding a big insulated tumbler cup with a straw, and make my toe nails painted white. The porch: white board-and-batten walls, black window frames, a black front door, a black lantern wall light, a doormat and a rocking chair, with green fields and a wooden fence behind. The oversized camo t-shirt hangs long like a t-shirt dress over short black shorts, no shoes on, hair in a messy bun. The shocked face looks off to the left at something just out of the frame, the look of a wife who just saw what her husband brought home: eyebrows up, mouth a little open. Exactly one person in the picture, the person from the uploaded image: nobody else, no child, no baby, no second adult. Keep the body shape and body size exactly as in the photo. The camo is a plain brown and green leafy hunting camo print with no logo; no brand names or logos on the clothes. No badges, brand names, logos or license plate text on any vehicle. Vertical 9:16, one full-body phone photo from head to toe, natural late-afternoon light, photorealistic, like a real snapshot. No text, no captions, no stickers, no signs, no watermark, no frame.
